title: MigrationScan
description: Result of scanning native backend configs. Rows marked import can be taken over by Model Hub; the native credential is removed only after the engine has accepted and verified the replacement.

masked_detail.description: e.g. 'sk-…dd3c + 自定义 Base URL'; never full secrets

proposed_action.description: API keys and file-backed Claude/Codex subscription OAuth use import. Keychain-only OAuth remains keep_native because the CLI does not expose exportable token material. controlled_import remains reserved.

notes_key.description: i18n key for the row's secondary line

vendor.description: Additive presentation metadata (ratified 2026-09-19). The provider this credential belongs to — an OpenCode row carries its native provider id. Optional: a client that does not receive it falls back to masked_detail and a generic icon, and never infers provider identity from `backend`.

display_name.description: Additive presentation metadata. The server's own label for the provider. Not guaranteed friendly — OpenCode currently emits the provider id — so a client maps known vendors to brand names and falls back to this label, then to the slug.

masked_credential.description: Additive presentation metadata. The masked credential alone, produced by the same masking the composed masked_detail used, so a client can render provider and key separately without re-parsing that string. Never a plaintext secret; null on rows that have no credential of their own.
